display.purpose: Book titles on the cover and the book-opening title page; Finish band; page-number input.

band.purpose: Hero band labels, desktop goal band, level-up band.

label.purpose: Author, standard band labels, banner, errors.

fact.purpose: Price-line register for facts, hints, tab labels.

shadows.name: state-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected band. State mark only; no drop shadows exist in the system.

shadows.name: spine-accent-ring
shadows.purpose: Read week-spine and year-shelf-spine border, in the genre's accent ink.

patterns.name: band-pattern
patterns.purpose: One tone-on-tone SVG endpaper repeat per genre (var(--g-<genre>-pattern)), 5-10% ink opacity, layered under the flat genre colour on the cover bands, the thumbnail placeholder, week/year-shelf spines, and inside the book-opening cover. The only surface pattern in the system; always paired with the flat fill, never used alone.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for fills, slides, hinges; EASE_OUT in Motion.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: Press and colour changes. Reduced 80ms, Off 0.

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Small moves, cover swap. Reduced 140ms, Off 0.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Sheets, spines sliding into slots, level-up wipe. Reduced 200ms, Off 0.

motion.name: dur-4
motion.purpose: Band, goal and Reader No. fills. Reduced 240ms, Off 0.

motion.name: motion-setting
motion.value: :root[data-motion='full'|'reduced'|'off']; dur(pref, s) caps Motion at 0.2s Reduced, 0 Off
motion.purpose: Reader's choice, else Reduced when the OS prefers reduced motion, else Full.

motion.name: book-opening
motion.value: ~1.7s sequence at Full (Motion library, HEFT ease [0.45,0,0.25,1] for the board swing, EASE_OUT for the page-grow): cover swings open on its left spine revealing a two-page spread with the genre endpaper inside the covers, 4 leaves turn in a staggered sequence (stagger 0.12s, start 0.45s), then the title page zooms and grows to become the white session page. Reduced fades straight to the session page (dur('reduced', 0.25)); Off skips instantly.
motion.purpose: Signature: the cover is the screen, and opening it on its spine is how the session begins.

motion.name: celebration-scale
motion.value: session band fill < level-up band wipe < finished-book full-screen ink flood

components.name: Hero Band (Start reading)
components.description: The bottom band of the cover; the primary action, full width, 88px, in the book's pastel ink with a progress rule along its top edge.
components.css: .ds-band-hero{position:relative;display:flex;width:100%;min-height:88px;padding:20px 24px 12px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--band, #d3c7ef);color:var(--band-on, #1f1d24);font-family: var(--font, 'Cabin Variable', 'Gill Sans', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif);font-weight:700;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-band-hero__c{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;width:100%}.ds-band-rule{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--band-deep, #ab9be0) 30%,var(--band, #d3c7ef))}.ds-band-fill{display:block;height:100%;width:42%;background:var(--band-deep, #ab9be0)}.ds-band-hero:active{background:var(--band-deep, #ab9be0);color:var(--band-deep-on, #1f1d24)}.ds-band-hero:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--band-on, #1f1d24);outline-offset:-7px}

components.name: Band

components.css: .ds-band{display:flex;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:48px;margin-bottom:8px;padding:0 24px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--band, #d3c7ef);color:var(--band-on, #1f1d24);font-family: var(--font, 'Cabin Variable', 'Gill Sans', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif);font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.25;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-band:active{background:var(--band-deep, #ab9be0);color:var(--band-deep-on, #1f1d24)}.ds-band[aria-pressed="true"]{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--band-on, #1f1d24)}.ds-band:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--band-on, #1f1d24);outline-offset:-7px}

narrative.overview:
Wink is set like a 1935 paperback cover: a flat genre-coloured band on top, a white title band in the middle, a genre band at the bottom. The reader's current book fills Home as that cover, and its bottom band is the Start reading control. Everything else in the app is built from the same material: bands of flat ink, white title bands, numbered spines on a shelf, and a small price-line register for facts ("Print · p. 312 of 736 · about 16 sessions left"). There is one typeface, a humanist sans in the Johnston/Gill line, used in bold mixed case for titles and spaced caps inside bands.

The density is low and the scale is large. Controls are whole bands, tall enough for a thumb, not buttons floating on cards. Objects sit on a cool shelf grey so the white title band reads as paper and the cover reads as an object. The world is flat: no gradients, no drop shadows, no cream paper. Depth comes from colour blocks, from a quiet tone-on-tone endpaper texture inside each genre band, and from motion. The cover hinges open on its spine into a two-page spread, its leaves turn, bands fill left to right, numbers roll, and spines slide into their slots.

Motion follows one grammar and has three settings (Full, Reduced, Off). Celebration grows with significance: a finished session fills a band, a level-up wipes a band across the Reader No. line, and a finished book floods the whole screen in the book's ink.
keyCharacteristics: Tri-band composition: genre band, white title band, genre band.
Every book paints in its genre's ink through six generic properties (band, band-on, band-deep, band-deep-on, band-accent, band-pattern).
One humanist sans (Cabin Variable), tabular numerals throughout.
Flat colour, 3px corners at most, no drop shadows; a tone-on-tone endpaper texture is the one permitted surface pattern.
Bands are the controls, at least 48px tall and 88px for the hero.
Motion scales with significance and obeys Full / Reduced / Off.

rules.name: The Book Paints Itself Rule
rules.body: Colour in any component comes from the current book's genre through the band, band-on, band-deep, band-deep-on, band-accent and band-pattern properties (`genreVars()`). No component hard-codes a genre hue.

rules.name: The Always-Paper Rule
rules.body: A surface that is always white (the cover body, sheets, the session page, the welcome cover) carries `.on-paper`, which pins light-theme ink in both themes. Dark mode dims the paper; it never inverts it.

rules.name: The Pressed Goes Deep Rule
rules.body: A band's active state swaps to its deep ink and deep-on text. When the band is already deep (the Finish save band), pressing takes it to Press Black.

rules.name: The Accent Is A Line, Not A Fill Rule
rules.body: `band-accent` (a saturated pull of the genre hue) only ever draws a thin rule or a 1px inset border — the cover/title-page divider, the week-spine and year-shelf-spine outline. It never fills a surface; fills stay on band/band-deep.

rules.name: The Caps Live In Bands Rule
rules.body: Spaced caps belong to band text (genre, Reader No., sheet titles, spines, the Finished stamp). They never sit above a heading as a label or kicker.

rules.name: The Price Line Rule
rules.body: Facts go on one line in the fact register, separated by middle dots, with tabular figures: "Print · p. 312 of 736 · about 16 sessions left".

rules.name: The Flat Stack Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. To separate one layer from another, use a colour block, a 1 to 2px rule, a scrim, or the tone-on-tone endpaper pattern. Inset rings in currentColor are allowed only to mark a state such as selected or next.

dos: **Do** paint components through band / band-on / band-deep / band-deep-on / band-accent / band-pattern from `genreVars()`, never a literal genre hex.
**Do** keep every genre ink/on and deep/deep-on pair at 4.5:1 or better and extend `genres.test.ts` when adding an ink. The current hues are pending owner approval.
**Do** keep `band-accent` to thin rules and 1px borders only; never use it as a fill.
**Do** keep the endpaper pattern quiet (5-10% ink opacity) and always layered under the flat band colour, never used alone.
**Do** put `.on-paper` on any surface that stays white in both themes.
**Do** make the band itself the control: full width, at least 48px, 88px for the primary action.

**Do** time every CSS transition with `--dur-1..4` (160 / 320 / 560 / 900ms) and `--ease-out`, and every Motion animation with `dur(pref, seconds)` and `EASE_OUT`, so Full / Reduced / Off governs all motion.
**Do** scale celebration with significance: a session fills a band, a level-up wipes a band, a finished book floods the screen.
**Do** set facts in the price-line register with tabular figures.
donts: **Don't** use drop shadows or gradients. Inset currentColor rings for selected or next state, and the endpaper texture, are the only departures from flat colour.
**Don't** round corners past 3px, and don't round full-width bands at all.
**Don't** use cream or warm paper. Title White is pure white, dimmed to Bedtime Grey (#dedfe0) at night.
**Don't** build dashboards of cover-thumbnail cards, stat tiles or progress rings. Progress is a band fill, a spine or a rule.
**Don't** set caps outside a band, or as a kicker above a heading.
